description: The Xiaomi Power Bank 4i 10000mAh is a sleek, compact, and high-performance portable charger designed for users who need reliable power on the go. With its powerful 10000mAh lithium-ion battery, this power bank can efficiently charge your smartphone, tablet, earbuds, smartwatch, and other USB-powered devices multiple times throughout the day. It supports 22.5W fast charging with Power Delivery (PD) and Quick Charge 3.0 technologies, ensuring rapid and safe charging for a wide range of devices. Whether you're using the USB-C or dual USB-A outputs, you can charge up to three devices simultaneously, making it ideal for multitaskers and frequent travellers. One of the standout features of this model is its two-way fast charging, allowing the USB-C port to function for both input and output. This reduces the time required to recharge the power bank itself, taking approximately 4 hours with a fast charger. Xiaomi has also included a Low Power Discharge Mode, activated by double-pressing the power button, which is perfect for charging low-consumption devices like fitness bands, Bluetooth earbuds, and smartwatches. The design is both functional and premium, featuring a robust anodized alum
